preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= 10**9 for l, r in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the range of cans l to r is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, and l is less than or equal to r.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'YES' if any(a for a in range(l, r+1) if (x % a) >= a / 2 for x in range(l, r+1)) else stdout[i] == 'NO' for i, (l, r) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if there exists a pack size a such that for every x in the range [l, r], the customer buys more than x cans; otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
